policy: Checks follow each predeclared input rubric in order and the Qwen3 review standard. EOS indicates generation termination only. Semantically clear paraphrases count; partial diagnostic steps do not. Latency comparison requires implementation dependence. Measurements beyond provided overall percentiles do not establish internal stage causality. Formatting, arithmetic and brevity issues are noted without inventing rubric items. No benchmark or deployment claim.
